call: POST /x402/agent/register (prepare) then POST /send-transactions with X-PAYMENT (send + pay)
prepare_notes: executionMode is brickken-relayed; signerAddress must be omitted (400 if present: 'signerAddress must be omitted for brickken-relayed execution'). Returns txId, transactions (from = Brickken's own relayer wallet, not ours), and x402Requirements pointing at POST /send-transactions.

errors.name: Server Error

reproduced: Twice, from a fresh prepare each time (fresh txId/agentUuid), identical 500 both times -- deterministic, not a transient flake.
verified_no_charge: Base Sepolia USDC balance confirmed unchanged (20.00) after both failed attempts via direct eth_call -- the x402 payment reservation was released on failure, exactly as Brickken's docs describe.
root_cause: Server-side crash inside Brickken's own settlement code for this route: an ESM/CommonJS interop bug importing axios (a named export that only exists on axios's CJS build), not anything in our request. Same X-PAYMENT construction (EIP-3009, exact scheme) worked cleanly seconds earlier against POST /faucet/bkn.
